items.answer: A data analyst typically pulls data using SQL, cleans it, explores it to find patterns, builds charts and dashboards, and writes up findings with recommendations. They also spend significant time clarifying questions and checking data trustworthiness.

Core skills for a frontend developer include HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and a component framework like React. Important supporting skills are accessibility, responsive layout, calling HTTP APIs, version control using Git, browser developer tools, and component testing.

To get started in UX design, learn the fundamentals of usability and practise on real problems. You can pick an everyday app, test it with three people, and redesign one flow based on what you observed. Your portfolio should showcase your process and reasoning, including any changes made after testing, rather than just final screens.
A data analyst mainly explains past events using SQL, descriptive statistics, and visualisation, while a data scientist focuses more on prediction, experimentation, modelling, and machine learning.

UX design focuses on how a product works, including the steps, structure, and task completion, appealing to those who enjoy research and problem framing. UI design focuses on the visual and interactive surface, such as layout, type, colour, and components, appealing to those who enjoy visual craft and detail. They overlap heavily, and a product designer does both.
A DevOps engineer builds and maintains the systems that take software from a developer's machine to reliable operation in production.

Core skills for a machine learning engineer include strong software engineering in Python, machine learning fundamentals, a deep learning framework, and model evaluation. Important supporting skills are data pipelines, deployment with containers and cloud services, monitoring, and for language-model applications, prompt design, retrieval and systematic evaluation.

To get started as a backend developer, pick one language and build a small API with a real database that handles creating, reading, updating, and deleting records, and then add login. Learn SQL properly instead of relying only on libraries. Finally, deploy the project, add tests, and practise explaining your design choices.

QA engineers frequently transition into test automation engineering, backend development, DevOps, or product roles because their testing experience gives them a broad understanding of product behavior.

A product designer is responsible for managing a feature from the initial understanding of the problem all the way to the final interface, combining user experience design, user interface design, and an understanding of business and product needs.

To get started as a UX researcher, practise core methods on a small scale. You can interview five people about how they complete a task, run a usability test on an existing app, and write a short report separating your observations from your conclusions. An early key skill is learning to ask about past behaviour instead of opinions.
A data engineer builds the pipelines and storage that move data from where it is created to where analysts, data scientists and applications can use it.

People who enjoy visual craft and detail such as typography, colour, and layout tend towards UI design. A UI designer focuses on the visual and interactive surface, including layout, typography, colour, components, and their states.

Frontend development focuses on interfaces, design detail, and accessibility. Backend development focuses on APIs, business logic, and data storage. Both require programming fundamentals, Git, and testing. Trying a small project of each kind is the most reliable way to find your preference.

Treat your assessment score as a starting point rather than a verdict. Use the topic breakdown to identify your weakest areas, review the explanations for missed questions, and select one or two topics to study before attempting the assessment again. Keep in mind that a higher score indicates related roles might align with your skills, though personal interest and practice are equally important.

To get started as a mobile developer, you should choose one platform and build a simple complete app that saves data on the device, such as a notes or expense tracker. You then need to add a network call and handle situations where the network is unavailable. Publishing even a small app will teach you the full release process.
Site reliability engineering is a closely related role to DevOps engineering that focuses on keeping services available and fast.

A software tester, or QA engineer, designs test cases from requirements, conducts exploratory testing on new features, writes and maintains automated tests, reports bugs clearly with steps to reproduce them, and verifies that fixed bugs stay fixed.
Data analysis is a common starting point for transitioning into data science. You can move towards data science by adding programming in Python, statistics, and model evaluation to your skill set.
I cannot answer what your first projects should be based on the provided text.
A data engineer builds the pipelines and storage that move data, and models tables in a data warehouse.
Data scientists design and analyse experiments such as A/B tests as part of their day-to-day work.
A UX design portfolio should show your process and reasoning, including what you changed after testing, rather than only displaying final screens.
With large language models, a machine learning engineer increasingly builds applications that involve retrieval and evaluation.
Yes, SQL is considered a core skill for a data analyst and is used for pulling data.
Backend developers often grow into full-stack development, DevOps and site reliability work, or data engineering.
A backend developer should know one server-side language such as Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript, as well as relational databases and SQL, HTTP and API design, and data structures and algorithms.

A typical day for a UX designer includes talking to users, mapping user flows, sketching wireframes, building prototypes, running usability tests, and refining the design based on what is learned. They also work closely with product managers and developers throughout the process.

To get started as a data engineer, become very good at SQL and comfortable in Python. Build a small pipeline that pulls data from a public API on a schedule, cleans it, loads it into a database, and checks its quality. Additionally, learning how to model tables for analysis is as important as learning tools.

Frontend developers often transition towards full-stack development by learning backend skills, move towards design engineering and UI design by developing deeper visual and interaction skills, or explore mobile development as a close neighbour sharing interface thinking.

A QA engineer, also known as a software tester, is responsible for finding problems before users encounter them and helping teams build quality into their processes. Their role includes planning what to test, conducting manual testing, and writing automated tests.
To become a data scientist, you should build a base in statistics and Python. You can also transition from data analysis by adding programming in Python, statistics, and model evaluation.

A UX designer shapes how a product works for the people using it, focusing on task steps, information organisation, and goal achievement. A product designer takes responsibility for a feature from initial problem understanding to the final interface, combining UX design, UI design, and product and business needs.

A UX researcher studies product users so teams can base decisions on evidence instead of assumptions. The role involves planning studies, gathering data, and turning that data into actionable findings.

Core skills for a DevOps engineer include Linux, networking fundamentals, scripting, continuous integration and delivery, containers, and at least one cloud platform. Important supporting skills include infrastructure as code, monitoring and logging, security basics, and calm, systematic troubleshooting.

To get started in mobile app development, you can choose one platform and build a simple complete app, such as a notes or expense tracker that saves data on the device. Next, add a network call and handle the case where the network is unavailable. Publishing even a small app will teach you the full release process.
Data engineers often move into analytics engineering, machine learning engineering, or data platform and architecture roles.

A UI designer works on the visual and interactive surface of a product, which includes designing screens and components, defining styles for typography, color, and spacing, and specifying states like hover, focus, error, and loading. They also maintain design systems and collaborate with developers to ensure the final build matches the design.
